newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI KINDLUSTUS PREMIUMS UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: EESTI KINDLUSTUS PREMIUMS UP IN APRIL.

text.p: Eesti Kindlustus, Estonia's largest insurance company owned by Hoiupank , collected 20 million kroons of premiums in April compared to 18.6 million kroons in March, it said on Wednesday.
Non-life insurance premiums made up 83 percent or 16.6 million kroons and life insurance premiums 17 percent or 3.4 million kroons, it added in a statement.
Premium collection has increased by 1.3 times compared to the same period in 1996, it said.
Eesti Kindlustus made payments of 6.5 million kroons in April, of which 5.1 million kroons were for non-life insurance policies.
During the first four months of this year, it collected 70.6 million kroons of payments compared to 58.3 million kroons in the same period in 1996.
